preconditions.description: The number of stewards n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 1000000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each steward's strength a_i must be between 0 and 1000000000.
The length of the list of strengths must equal the number of stewards n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for a_i in a if any(a_j < a_i for a_j in a) and any(a_j > a_i for a_j in a)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of stewards that Jon Snow will support, which is the number of stewards with strength strictly between the minimum and maximum strengths.
